svg.aria-label: Agent Fleet architecture: an orchestrator plans a goal, departments of agents run it in sandboxed harnesses, every step is reviewed, and a knowledge graph feeds context.
svg.text: a business goal goes in, checked work comes out
turns a goal into a plan
every finished job is stored and connected, so the next one starts from what already worked
answers stay grounded in your own sources, and lean context keeps running costs low
